'''Matt Quirk''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at a sanctioned tournament in Rochester, New York on 31 July 1999 with Throne Room (Sense/Alter), according to Dan Kurycki's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-11-rochester-ny-7-31-99d3/ rochester-ny-7-31-99], DeckTech (Dan "Giddyup21" Kurycki, 11 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-11-rochester-ny-7-31-99d3/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
